questions.en: With default deserialization settings, contrast an unknown property that no handler accepts with a JSON null mapped to a Java int.
questions.fr: Avec les réglages de désérialisation par défaut, comparez une propriété inconnue sans gestionnaire et un null JSON converti en int Java.

facts.expected: An unhandled unknown property causes a JsonMappingException by default.

anchors.text:
* This setting only takes effect after all other handling * methods for unknown properties have been tried, and * property remains unhandled. *

* Feature is enabled by default (meaning that a * {@link JsonMappingException} will be thrown if an unknown property * is encountered). */ FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES(true),

facts.expected: A JSON null mapped to a Java int uses the primitive default 0 because FAIL_ON_NULL_FOR_PRIMITIVES is disabled.

anchors.text:
/** * Feature that determines whether encountering of JSON null * is an error when deserializing into Java primitive types * (like 'int' or 'double'). If it is, a {@link InvalidNullException} * is thrown to indicate this; if not, default value is used * (0 for 'int', 0.0 for double, same defaulting as what JVM uses). *

* Feature is disabled by default for Jackson 2.x: will be changed * to enabled in 3.0. */ FAIL_ON_NULL_FOR_PRIMITIVES(false),

questions.en: What does ACCEPT_CASE_INSENSITIVE_PROPERTIES canonicalize during matching, and is it enabled by default?
questions.fr: Quels noms de propriétés ACCEPT_CASE_INSENSITIVE_PROPERTIES normalise-t-il lors de la comparaison, et est-il activé par défaut ?

facts.expected: Incoming and matching property names are lowercased.

anchors.text:
* If enabled, the bean properties will be matched using their lower-case equivalents,
     * meaning that any case-combination (incoming and matching names are canonicalized
     * by lower-casing) should work.

facts.expected: The feature is disabled by default.

questions.en: Why must an ObjectMapper subclass override copy(), and how does JsonMapper implement that contract?
questions.fr: Pourquoi une sous-classe d’ObjectMapper doit-elle redéfinir copy(), et comment JsonMapper respecte-t-il ce contrat ?

facts.expected: ObjectMapper.copy performs an exact runtime-class check that throws IllegalStateException for an unhandled subclass.
The runtime-class mismatch throws IllegalStateException and asks for an override.
JsonMapper checks for JsonMapper.class and returns a newly copied JsonMapper.

questions.en: How does the ObjectMapper copy constructor initialize serialization and deserialization configuration, and do populated serializer caches carry over?
questions.fr: Comment le constructeur de copie d’ObjectMapper initialise-t-il la configuration de sérialisation et de désérialisation, et les caches de sérialiseurs déjà remplis sont-ils repris ?

facts.expected: New SerializationConfig and DeserializationConfig objects are initialized from the original mapper's configuration and the new mapper's copied collaborators.
The cached serializers and deserializers are not carried over.

anchors.text:
* Although configuration is shared, cached serializers and deserializers
     * are NOT shared, which means that the new instance may be re-configured
     * before use; meaning that it behaves the same way as if an instance
     * was constructed from scratch.

questions.en: In the implementation behind readTree(InputStream), which JsonNode is actually returned for empty input, and which for the literal JSON null?
questions.fr: Dans l’implémentation appelée par readTree(InputStream), quel JsonNode est réellement renvoyé pour un flux vide, puis pour le littéral JSON null ?

facts.expected: No token after advancing produces the configured factory's missingNode.
A VALUE_NULL token produces the configured factory's nullNode.

questions.en: If I pass Java null to ObjectNode.set for an existing property, is the key removed? Which method would remove it?
questions.fr: Si je passe null à ObjectNode.set pour une propriété existante, la clé est-elle supprimée ? Quelle méthode permettrait de la supprimer ?

facts.expected: set replaces the value with a NullNode and retains the field.
Use remove to remove the property.

anchors.text:
* @param propertyName Name of property to set
     * @param value Value to set property to; if null, will be converted
     *   to a {@link NullNode} first  (to remove a property, call
     *   {@link #remove} instead)

questions.en: What kind of node does ObjectNode.path return for an unknown field, and what does calling asText() on it return?
questions.fr: Quel type de nœud ObjectNode.path renvoie-t-il pour un champ inconnu, et que renvoie ensuite asText() sur ce nœud ?

facts.expected: An absent field gets the MissingNode singleton.

questions.en: In ObjectMapper._convert, what happens when its input is already a TokenBuffer, and how is root wrapping handled for other inputs?
questions.fr: Dans ObjectMapper._convert, que se passe-t-il si l’entrée est déjà un TokenBuffer, et comment l’enveloppe de racine est-elle traitée pour les autres entrées ?

facts.expected: An existing TokenBuffer is reused directly.
WRAP_ROOT_VALUE is disabled when serializing other inputs.

questions.en: Does ordinary ObjectMapper root binding, by default, verify that no JSON token follows the first value, and how can that check be enabled?
questions.fr: Par défaut, ObjectMapper vérifie-t-il qu’aucun jeton JSON ne suit la première valeur lors de la désérialisation, et comment activer ce contrôle ?

facts.expected: Root reading performs its final token check if FAIL_ON_TRAILING_TOKENS is enabled.

questions.en: What is the exact custom deserializer class registered by my private service in its production ObjectMapper?
questions.fr: Quel est le nom exact de la classe de désérialisation personnalisée enregistrée dans l’ObjectMapper de mon service privé en production ?
